Increasingly, a low carbon footprint is viewed very positively by all stakeholders, and reducing the footprint will yield benefits on multiple fronts. As mentioned earlier, the Company has been measuring and focusing on reducing the carbon footprint at various facilities, through many energy-saving schemes.
